## tmh webhook-subscriptions create

Create a webhook subscription

### Synopsis

Subscribes an HTTPS endpoint to event types and creates its signing secret. Requires the `webhooks:manage` or `org:admin` scope.

Scopes: org:admin or webhooks:manage

```
tmh webhook-subscriptions create [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -d, --data stringArray                body field as key=value (dotted keys nest, key[]=v appends, key:=<json> sends JSON), or the whole body as @file, @- for stdin, or a JSON document; repeatable. Flags override -d fields, which override the document
      --description string              A description for your own reference.
      --endpoint-url string             The HTTPS URL to deliver events to. (required)
      --event-types strings             The event types to deliver; one of: enrollment.certified, seat.consumed, seat.freed, learner.invited, learner.started, learner.certified, learner.expiring, learner.expired, learner.removed, invite.bounced, certificate.revoked, seats.low (required)
  -h, --help                            help for create
      --seats-low-threshold seats.low   Send seats.low when available seats drop to this number. Defaults to 5.
```
